jobPostingInfo.title: Senior Program Manager, Fleet Rollouts
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
GLOBEX builds field robotics for warehouses across Australia. This fictional posting is test data for LVLme.

What you'll be doing:

  • Run the rollout of autonomous fleets at customer warehouses, from site survey to handover.
  • Coordinate engineering, operations and customer teams against one deployment plan.
  • Report progress and risks to the leadership team every week.

What we need to see:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of program management in logistics, robotics or industrial operations.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams through complex hardware deployments.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience deploying autonomous mobile robots.
  • Familiarity with warehouse management systems.

Globex Labs is an equal opportunity employer. Globex values every applicant.
